audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1-3 were split Skill/Yorick/Yorick and level 6 read Skill, none of which matches the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: The mirror (garen__yorick.json) set levels 1, 2 and 3 to Garen at 7/10, 6/10, 6/10 and levels 4-5 and 6 to Yorick. Both directions must state the same result, and Garen genuinely owns the first three levels: a 300-range silence and burst against a Yorick with no swarm yet.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-2 to Garen at 3/10, 4/10, 4/10 (inverse of the mirror's ratings); rows 3 and 4 to Yorick, their 6/10 already correct. Proposed as matched full/content pairs, with whys[0], whys[1], whys[2] and whys[4] restated so the prose no longer says 'even' next to a decided row.

audit.why: Spike stages are right: your window is 3-5 into 6, his is items and the R pick.
audit.corrected: Kept; added that Demacian Justice is true damage and an execute, so staying topped through Maiden — not resistances — is the answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five separate strings call Decisive Strike a dash — 'Q silence-dash', 'his Q dash can't reach you', 'if he Q-dashes in', 'any Q-dash engage', 'wall off his Q silence-dash'. Garen has no dash in his kit.
audit.why: Decisive Strike is a burst of move speed plus an empowered, silencing next attack. It also breaks free of all slows on cast, which the page never says — that is the ability that answers Mourning Mist, and it is why a cage placed on his feet does nothing while a cage across his walking path does everything.
audit.corrected: Removed the invented dash everywhere, stated the slow purge, gave the flat 8s cooldown as the sequencing cue, and recorded the auto-attack reset wind-up as the trade tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere in this matchup.
audit.why: Every 'when it is down' line named Courage without a number.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are even — Garen wants to walk up, Q Decisive Strike to silence and burst, then spin E and back off behind his passive regen. Don't get silenced mid-combo: respect his Q range, farm with Last Rites, and keep your E charge for when your W is online. Neither of you kills the other here if you play the wave cleanly and don't eat a free Q-E trade.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are his — Garen walks up, Q Decisive Strike to silence and burst, then spins E and backs off behind his passive regen. Decisive Strike is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast. Farm with Last Rites, respect the 300-range Q, and hold your E charge until W is online rather than proving a point.

edits.before: At 3 the lane opens for you: W Dark Procession caging Garen, E Mourning Mist for the slow, and free autos where his Q dash can't reach you. Your ghouls chew through him faster than his W tenacity and regen can heal, so trade under the wall and out-shove with ghouls and Maiden through 6. His R execute is a pick tool — stay topped with Maiden and it never triggers. This is your window to build a lead before he spikes on items.
edits.after: At 3 the lane opens for you: W Dark Procession caging Garen, E Mourning Mist for the slow, and free autos while he walks — there is no dash in his kit. Decisive Strike purges that slow and silences you on a flat 8s cooldown, so open the moment it is spent. Your ghouls chew through him faster than his W tenacity and regen can heal. Demacian Justice is true damage and an execute — stay topped with Maiden and it never triggers.

edits.before: With Divine Sunderer your %-HP ghoul all-ins beat his Stridebreaker bruiser build, and any Q-dash engage just feeds your cage. Two-plus items you're the superior split-pusher: Maiden and ghouls let you siege and 1v1 or 1v2 a sidelane, while Garen can delete a squishy but can't kill you through Maiden or match your wave pressure across the map.
edits.after: With Divine Sunderer your %-HP ghoul all-ins beat his Stridebreaker bruiser build, and with no dash in his kit a cage between you is a walk he cannot make. Two-plus items you're the superior split-pusher: Maiden and ghouls let you siege and 1v1 or 1v2 a sidelane, while Garen can delete a squishy but can't kill you through Maiden or match your map pressure.
